turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Tomorrow's the rail strike and I've got a job interview across the city at ten.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Stressful timing. There's a replacement bus service, or you could take a bike from the share scheme. Which do you trust more?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, quick break, I need to talk to my roommate. I'll tell you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that was rude of me, go on.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's okay, I was only saying the cake's ready.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, what's that thing you ordered last time? The cold one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Cold brew with oat milk. It's really smooth.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it strong? I don't want to be awake all night.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Pretty strong. Maybe get a small one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I'll just have a tea and steal a sip of yours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: One sip. I know what you're like.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Getting to the interview was still the open bit. Bus, or bike?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The bus. I'll get the first one.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Smart. Replacement buses fill up fast, so the earliest one gives you a safety margin.
